svg.title: Anterior thigh: superficial layer
svg.desc: Anterior view of both thighs. Sartorius runs from the ASIS (lateral) obliquely to the medial proximal tibia. Quadriceps: rectus femoris centrally, vastus lateralis laterally, vastus medialis medially; the fourth member, vastus intermedius, is deep to rectus femoris and appears on the deep-thigh plate. Tensor fasciae latae, iliopsoas, adductor longus and gracilis are labelled.
